{{Top|leg}}
An '''amusement park''' was a park that featured thrill rides, shows, and other attractions. [[Hologram Fun World]],<ref name="Queen of the Empire">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''.</ref> [[Project Aralia]],<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species real-world book">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']].</ref> and [[Galaxy Ways]] were all amusement parks.<ref name="Trouble at Galaxy Ways">{{WEGCite|story=Trouble at Galaxy Ways|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen}}</ref>

[[Planet/Legends|Planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] had a large number of live-action roleplay theme parks where visitors could interact in-character with [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]], [[Actor/Legends|actors]] and other visitors while carrying out plots and adventures. Many [[Adarlonian|Adaronians]] had their home in the parks, spending much of their waking hours in their fictional roles. The rules of the parks dictated that everyone was to be treated as the character they were roleplaying as, at all times.<ref name="GG6-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
